description: Efficiently and safely use Progressive Web Research (XMLStock search + independent SSRF-safe fetch) as a clean model with no native web tools: one focused query, snippet-driven source selection, one fetch per URL, local research files, untrusted-content discipline.
entry_workflow: agent bootstrap (site, environment, actor, contracts, capabilities, skills)
verify research.search/research.fetch scopes; research.manage is NEVER needed by an agent
verify the progressive.web-research extension is deployed and enabled (cms research status)
select only promising URLs (typically 3-8; never fetch the whole SERP)
cms research fetch URL --out research/<n>.md --json, one URL at a time
read the local files, assess relevance/quality, keep provenance
re-search with a reformulated query only if evidence is missing
use findings in the content workflow (PCMD/.pcpub is a separate skill)
